schema_documentation:
Two disjoint key-sets (a mixed key-space, not one schema).

**`metadata.jsonl` — 3,719 records (99.97% of the directory):**
| key | type | presence | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `filename` | str | 100%, always exactly 10 chars | `AAJ_009.md` — base-26 index; joins 1:1 to `openbook.gr/dataset/AAJ_009.jsonl` (set equality verified, 0 unmatched either way) |
| `url` | str | 100%, mean 250.7 ch, max 1,263 | source URL — 3,673/3,719 are `dl.dropboxusercontent.com` re-host links, not origins |
| `created_at` | str | 100% present, 86.96% non-empty (485 empty) | ISO-8601, e.g. `2025-07-29T10:26:23+00:00` — ingest timestamp, not publication date |
| `modified_at` | str | 100% present, 86.96% non-empty | same value as `created_at` in every record I read |
| `issues` | str | 100% present, only 1.88% non-empty | 5-value enum: `''` 3,649 / `encrypted – password-protected` 50 / `scanned – no embedded fonts (pdffonts)` 15 / `unknown – text extraction failed` 4 / `encrypted…; scanned…` 1 |
| `__index_level_0__` | int | 100% | HuggingFace row index, range 9–6,349, non-contiguous |

**`README.jsonl` — 1 record (0.03%):**
| key | type | presence | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `text` | str | 1 record, 5,170 chars | the data card: YAML front-matter (`token_count: 133550088`, `word_count: 83989052`, `size_bytes: 981787848`, `license: CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0`) followed by an English Markdown README |
semantic_meaning: Metadata sidecar for openbook.gr: a 3,719-row provenance table plus one English data-card record. Contains no Greek training text.
split_group_rule: Hash originating source identity; dictionary group by normalized lemma; recipes by normalized recipe title conservatively across ingredient variants; sentiment by complete normalized review content. Global duplicate components must share a split.
validation_rules: Rebuild full user prompt and answer from preserved evidence
Independent Greek grammar/naturalness review remains mandatory
Verified license and privacy clearance required for release
